titre: Devoir de synthèse n°2 - Anglais (8ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Water is one of the most precious things on Earth. All living beings – humans, animals and plants – need water to live. We use water to drink, to cook, to wash and to grow our food. However, clean water is becoming rare in many parts of the world. Some people waste a lot of water every day: they leave the tap open while brushing their teeth or they use too much water in the garden. We must all learn to save water. For example, we can take shorter showers, repair leaking taps and reuse water for plants. If we do not protect water today, future generations will suffer tomorrow.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Why is water so important? Give one reason from the text.   (1,5 marks)
2) What is the problem mentioned in the text?   (1,5 marks)
3) Give two ways to save water mentioned in the text.   (2 marks)
4) What will happen if we do not protect water?   (1 mark)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "must / mustn't": We ______ waste water.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete the first conditional: If we save water, future generations ______ (not / suffer).   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "precious" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Put into the passive: "People waste a lot of water."   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"How can we save water and protect our environment?" Write a composition (about 10-12 lines) giving at least two solutions and explaining why they are important. Use "must / should" and linkers.
